concerns.text: The plan proposes applying paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests to per‑sample Calibration Error (ECE) and Sharpness vectors across methods. However, both Calibration Error (as defined) and Sharpness are scalar summary statistics computed per method‑dataset pair, not per‑sample quantities. Consequently there are no paired observations for the Wilcoxon test, rendering the statistical comparison invalid. The analysis should either (a) compute per‑sample quantities suitable for paired testing (e.g., absolute prediction errors, interval widths, binary coverage indicators) or (b) use an appropriate method for comparing scalar metrics across methods such as bootstrap confidence intervals or permutation tests.
